items.title: PB Fintech loses Rs 42,000 cr in 7 sessions, hits 32-month low
items.description: PB Fintech, the parent company of Policybazaar, has seen a significant decline in its stock value. Following a consultation paper from Irdai proposing caps on distributor commissions, the stock price has plummeted. The market capitalisation fell from ₹87,290 crore to ₹45,174 crore over the past seven sessions. This decline represents a loss of over 48% during this period. The stock is back at its initial public offering price of ₹980.

items.title: Stocks in news: Vedanta, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Marico, Axis Bank, Trent and Zydus Lifesciences
items.description: Indian equity markets showed signs of recovery on Monday after softer-than-expected US jobs data was released. The Nifty 50 index ended the session up, suggesting improved investor confidence. Investors are watching key corporate updates from companies like Vedanta and Kotak Mahindra Bank for future trends. Firms reported various operational advancements and financial performance improvements for the quarter. The overall sentiment in the market remains cautiously optimistic amid external economic influences.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The stock market's positive open saw the Nifty rise by 0.6%, breaking an eight-week streak of losses. Experts note a potential rebound in Indian stocks, driven by favorable Q2 business reports and strong bank results. However, the rupee suffered as it depreciated against the US dollar amid escalating oil prices and exiting foreign funds.

items.title: Stock Radar: Engineers India stock hits fresh record high in September after decisive breakout; time to buy?
items.description: Engineers India Ltd broke out from two years of consolidation to reach a record high in September 2026. The company's stock has risen more than 11% in a month and over 30% in the last three months. Analysts suggest that short-term traders can consider buying the stock for potential targets above 330 levels. The technical setup indicates strong bullish momentum and potential upside towards 335 to 345 levels.

items.title: National Housing Bank likely to double affordable housing outlay for HFCs this fiscal
items.description: National Housing Bank plans to double the refinance and affordable housing funds for large housing finance companies. These funds will be available to companies seeking long-term and cheaper financing options. LIC Housing Finance, Bajaj Housing Finance, and others are likely to benefit from this increase. The funding is expected to help reduce reliance on banks while promoting growth in housing loans.
